Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Firm annual commitment for part:340010 – counter-proposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer; we value our long-standing relationship and prefer a firm, multi-year commitment.

We want to secure full coverage of part:340010. Your standard lead time is 42 days (sup:70410), yet the offer quotes 54 days. Our latest forecast shows 21,310 pcs per year (fc:340010@2026-09), and we are prepared to commit to a firm 23,400 pcs. Your 2026Q3 on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3), so reliability is central to us.

Could you provide a cost breakdown, your earliest possible lead time, and any cheaper variants? We propose the attached packages.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As a matter of corporate policy, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can offer a contract term of 24 months for a volume of 23400 pcs per year with Lieferzeit 42 days. Accommodating this increased volume and shorter lead time requires a premium, resulting in a price of €33.80 per unit. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Capacity situation – firm 23,400 pc commitment for part:340010
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the revised offer and the delivery schedule. We confirm a firm 23,400 pcs per year for part:340010 at the 42-day lead time.

Your 2026Q3 on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3) shows reliability must be anchored contractually. Our forecast change of 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09) means we cannot absorb shortages, so dependable coverage is essential.

A longer commitment lets you plan capacity with certainty, which we ask you to reflect in the price. Please review the three attached packages, which trade contract length for unit price, and let us know your earliest possible lead time.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that delivery record data into account, and we have already taken that volume change data into account.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €33.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Regarding your inquiry, 42 days is our earliest possible lead time. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

We accept the 36-month contract term to provide mutual planning certainty. In exchange for this extended duration, we reduce the unit price to €33.50. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €33.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
